reason: The plugin is primarily for repository analysis: it builds and queries a code graph to help the agent focus on relevant symbols/files and assess change impact within bounded tokens, with optional continuous sync and command/skill integration into DeepSeek Harness. This classification is based on README and package metadata, and aligns it with AI-assisted code intelligence rather than content creation or UI tooling.

summaries.zh: dsh-fovea 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供仓库代码图分析能力，通过 sketch、focus、dwell 和 impact 工具帮助代理快速聚焦相关代码并评估变更影响。
summaries.en: dsh-fovea is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds repository-intelligence tools to help an agent quickly focus on relevant code areas and estimate change impact within token limits.

capabilities: Builds a repository-level code graph and ranks semantic relevance for focused analysis
Provides LLM-facing tools to summarize structure and estimate change impact under token budgets
Executes filesystem, git, and ast-grep operations through harness runtime providers
Maintains session/workspace sync state and emits steering/context signals during agent lifecycle

reasons.code: README defines four core tools (fovea_sketch, fovea_focus, fovea_dwell, fovea_impact) and their repository-context behavior.
README documents a command surface (/fovea) and skill registration plus lifecycle integration hooks in DeepSeek Harness sessions for continuous sync.
README notes execution via ctx.fs and ctx.subprocess and mentions git/ast-grep-based discovery and impact calculations.
package.json declares a DSH bundle patch export, indicating integration as a plugin package rather than a standalone app.
